newsitem.title: USA: CEI Citicorp Holdings 3-part Eurobond deal.
newsitem.headline: CEI Citicorp Holdings 3-part Eurobond deal.

text.p: The following 144a Eurobond issue from CEI Citicorp Holdings SA was priced on Friday, according to lead manager Merrill Lynch & Co.
The company is an Argentine telecommunications conglomerate. Citicorp owns 40 percent of the company, according to Merrill Lynch officials.
